node.title: Prime-field E1 collision-free radius from folded L2 norms
node.statement: For a nonzero E1 class difference with raw representatives at swap distance s over quotient order N=2h, fold antipodes to alpha=sum_i c_i zeta^i and S=sum_i c_i^2. Odd-conjugate orthogonality and AM-GM give |Norm(alpha)|<=S^(h/2). Either S<=4s-2, or alpha=2 beta with |Norm(beta)|<=s^(h/2). Since every live pair-feasible prime is at least 2^250, all N=256 collisions with s<=4 and all N=512 collisions with s=1 are impossible. The first surviving bands reduce to profiles (a,b,c)=(4,2,0),(3,4,0) at N=256,s=5 and (1,2,0),(0,4,0) at N=512,s=2.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: replaces the crude L1 norm radius by an exact folded L2 bound. It does not control the surviving collision-pair ledger.
